description: An if condition of an object for expression that is null for a later element is an error
notes: The spec only says the if condition must evaluate to a boolean value and what true and false do; it doesn't say whether a null condition is an error. hashicorp/hcl reports one: ForExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go reports "Condition is null" when its check before iteration already gets null, and "Invalid 'for' condition" when the condition is null for a particular element.
reference_error: Invalid 'for' condition: The value of the 'if' clause must not be null
